Microsoft Fluent Emoji, Flat variant (MIT, see LICENSE), one SVG per avatar icon key of
`web/src/app/shared/avatars/avatar-catalog.ts`. Source: https://github.com/microsoft/fluentui-emoji
(`assets/<Name>/Flat/<name>_flat.svg`).

After adding or replacing a file here, run `npm run generate:avatars` and commit the regenerated
`avatar-art.generated.ts`.
